primitive.relation: the natural weight of a finite set, sum of the supplied natural weights of its members, with upstream GraphTheory.core.dom.weight_set w S := \sum_(v in S) w v canonical: GTMisc X128 x128_weight, Minor X190 x190_weight, Minor X199 x199_weight and GTMisc U13 gold_total are its body at T := G (the same binder and argument order) and are transparent aliases of it, related by conversion. Any finite carrier, any natural weights (zero weights included) and any set (the empty set weighs 0); no positivity hypothesis. GTBase.set_weights bridges it to the event and total weights fg_event_weight w [in S] and fg_total_weight w of GTBase.finite_graph, whose ratio predicates keep their own positive-total-weight guards.

finite-set-natural-sum.note: (G : sgraph) (w : G -> nat) (S : {set G}) : nat := \sum_(v in S) w v, the upstream body at T := G; definitional equality (conversion), zero weights and empty sets allowed
